design.title: Projects Management Page in Dashboard
design.summary: Add a dedicated Projects management section to the dashboard (modeled after Machines section) that displays all registered projects with live status, allows queue management across projects, and supports add/remove/scan operations. Backend APIs already exist — this is purely a frontend implementation.
design.reason: All project APIs already exist: GET /api/projects, POST /api/projects/add, POST /api/projects/remove, POST /api/projects/scan, GET /api/projects/queue, POST /api/projects/queue/add, POST /api/projects/queue/start, POST /api/projects/queue/clear, GET /api/projects/history, GET /api/projects/stats
design.approach: Add #projectsWrap card section with project cards grid, following the same interaction pattern as the Machines section. Selecting a project switches the Queue panel and Timeline to show that project's data.
alternatives_rejected: Tab navigation system — major UI restructure, overkill for current needs
Expand existing sidebar — limited space, poor UX for queue management

change_points.details: Reuse client-card patterns: horizontal scrollable card row, green/red status dots, selected state with border highlight. Add project-specific styles: queue progress bar, lock indicator, path truncation with ellipsis.

change_points.html_structure:
📁 Projects

Selected: -

change_points.details: selectedProject stores the path of the selected project. When set, Queue panel shows that project's queue instead of local queue.
async function loadProjects() { var res = await fetch('/api/projects'); projects = await res.json(); } — called in the main load/refresh cycle

Renders project cards in #projectsList. Each card shows: name, truncated path, status dot (green=has queue tasks, gray=idle, red=locked), queue summary (pending/running/done/failed counts), last run info. Cards are clickable via selectProject(path).

Sets selectedProject = path. Updates projectActions visibility. Loads project's queue via GET /api/projects/queue?path=<path>. Updates queueTarget label. Calls render() to refresh all views. When selectedProject is set, Queue panel uses project data instead of local data.

change_points.action: Add projectQueueStart(), projectQueueClear(), removeProject(), scanProjects(), showAddProject()
change_points.details: Each function calls the corresponding /api/projects/* endpoint. projectQueueStart() calls POST /api/projects/queue/start with path. scanProjects() calls POST /api/projects/scan then reloads. showAddProject() prompts for path then calls POST /api/projects/add.

When selectedProject is set: renderQueue uses project queue data. addTask() calls POST /api/projects/queue/add. startQueue() calls POST /api/projects/queue/start. clearQueue() calls POST /api/projects/queue/clear. When null, uses existing local behavior.

change_points.action: Add loadProjects() to refresh cycle and renderProjectsPage() to render()
change_points.details: loadProjects() runs in parallel with loadClients(). renderProjectsPage() called in render() function.

interaction_model.description: Three contexts: local (default), remote machine, or registered project. Project selection takes precedence. Selecting a project clears machine selection and vice versa.
interaction_model.queue_panel_behavior: Queue panel header shows '@ project-name' when a project is selected. All queue operations route to that project's API endpoints.
interaction_model.timeline_integration: When a project is selected, timeline loads that project's history via GET /api/projects/history?path=<path>

fields: last run: relative time + status icon

key_decisions.rationale: Consistent UX — users already understand select-card → actions-bar → queue-switch pattern from Machines
All 10+ project API endpoints already exist and are tested. ProjectManager module is complete.
Avoids ambiguity — only one context active at a time. Selecting project clears machine selection.

key_decisions.decision: Projects section always visible (unlike Machines which hides when no clients)
key_decisions.rationale: Projects is a primary feature. Show 'No projects registered' empty state with Scan button.

key_decisions.decision: Queue operations route through /api/projects/* endpoints when project selected
key_decisions.rationale: These endpoints handle cross-project path resolution and spawn detached child processes.
Projects status changes as queues run. Regular polling keeps cards up-to-date.

edge_cases: No projects registered → show empty state with 'Scan' and 'Add' buttons
Project directory deleted → show 'missing' badge, disable queue operations
Project locked by another process → show lock icon, allow queue add but warn on start
Many projects (10+) → horizontal scroll bar on .projects-bar (same as Machines)
Long Windows paths → truncate with ellipsis, show full path in title tooltip
Selecting project then machine → project clears, machine takes over (and vice versa)
design.scope_estimate: ~200 lines CSS + ~250 lines JS, all in public/dashboard.html
